name: Plugin UI adapter (portable part)

dependencies.reason: marker views read the chop map
pattern views read the pattern tree
the tree layout reads node summaries

threading: UI thread only. Views are derived from immutable snapshots and never mutate project state.
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/plugin_ui_adapter -B build/plugin_ui_adapter && cmake --build build/plugin_ui_adapter && ctest --test-dir build/plugin_ui_adapter
summary: Headless view models for the editor so geometry, text, and layout are unit-testable without a GUI: waveform peaks, drift-free time-to-pixel mapping with zoom/scroll, marker and pattern views, breadcrumbs, accessible descriptions, and history-tree layout.
limits: Colour is never the only indicator: every rectangle carries a text description
adapters: The JUCE editor draws these structures and sends commands to the composition root.
adapter_notes: Draw the view structs with your toolkit; route user actions to the composition root, not into the models.
removal: Delete the folder; the editor loses its view logic only.
